assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The unspecified atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.91.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction is coded as Z86.73.
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring via CPT 93271 is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management.
The service is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias responsible for the patient's symptoms and to inform stroke prevention decisions.
